_what: The Cooldown Room's vending machine, next to the ante-chamber at the Rebellion Rave Room. Ryan's brief, 2026-09-27: a free vending machine with snacks made by locals, and some fun ones made up. tools/make-cooldown.py writes every slot into cooldown-room.html between the cool-slots markers and refuses a snack that breaks the rules below. cooldown.js drops it into the tray and says so; it stores nothing and sends nothing.
_ours: EVERY SNACK AND EVERY MAKER HERE IS THIS STREET'S OWN, made up for this machine, like the hangar and the road. The makers are locals of The Outskirts, and none of them is a real business; a name here that turned out to belong to somebody real would be the room borrowing a reputation, so a maker is a first name and where on the road they are, never a brand.
_says: EVERY SNACK SAYS WHAT IS IN IT AND HOW IT FEELS BEFORE THE PRESS, which is the runtime rule arriving at a vending machine: the thing somebody decides with is on the glass. What it is made of is the whole list, not a highlight, so somebody avoiding something can see it; how it feels is texture, temperature and how strong it is, because in a room for coming down from somewhere loud, crunch and cold and sour are the things that matter.
_free: NOTHING IS PRICED AND NOTHING IS OWED. Take as many as you like; the machine does not run out and does not ask. Nothing For Sale's rule, on a machine built to take coins: taking puts nobody in anybody's debt. make-cooldown.py refuses a price, a cost and the vocabulary of paying back.
_no_verdict: NO SNACK IS GOOD OR BAD FOR YOU. The tool refuses healthy, junk, guilty, clean, cheat, a treat you have earned, calories, and anything a snack is supposed to DO for a body -- energy, fuel, recharge, boost -- with a negation window so the room can say it will not. Food at a rave is especially surrounded by that talk, and a cooldown room is exactly where it would arrive as a kindness.

snacks.name: Grape Hail
snacks.where: from the orchard off the verge
snacks.feels: Cold and hard, then crisp. They soften as they thaw.

snacks.name: Salt & Vinegar Static
snacks.where: who fries crisps behind the old control tower
snacks.in: potatoes, sunflower oil, sea salt, malt vinegar powder (from barley)
snacks.feels: A loud crunch, very salty and very sharp.

snacks.name: Cucumber Coins
snacks.in: cucumber, lime juice, chilli flakes, salt
snacks.feels: Cold, wet and crunchy, with a small kick of heat.

snacks.name: Plain Water Crackers
snacks.where: who bake overnight in the hut by the fuel pumps
snacks.in: wheat flour, water, a little salt
snacks.feels: Dry, crisp and plain, and exactly the same every time. The quietest thing in the machine.

snacks.name: Sour Laser Belts
snacks.where: from the sweet shed at the end of the strip
snacks.in: sugar, wheat flour, glucose syrup, citric acid, fruit and vegetable colours
snacks.feels: Chewy, then sharp. Every colour tastes the same.

snacks.name: Watermelon Cubes
snacks.where: from the orchard off the verge

snacks.name: Pretzel Knots
snacks.where: at the pretzel oven by the hangar doors
snacks.in: wheat flour, yeast, pretzel salt, peanut butter in the middle
snacks.feels: A hard, salty shell and a soft middle. There are peanuts in these.

snacks.name: Oat Squares
snacks.where: who bake overnight in the hut by the fuel pumps
snacks.in: oats, golden syrup, butter, a pinch of salt
snacks.feels: Soft, dense and a bit sticky, and not very sweet.

snacks.name: Mango Leather
snacks.where: who meet in the old departures lounge
snacks.feels: Chewy and tangy, and it bends a long way before it tears.

snacks.name: Ice Lollies

snacks.feels: Very cold, and they melt fast. Sticky fingers.

snacks.name: Smoked Chickpeas
snacks.in: chickpeas, olive oil, smoked paprika, salt
snacks.feels: Crunchy all the way through, and smoky.

snacks.name: Mint Chill Bars
snacks.where: from the sweet shed at the end of the strip
snacks.in: dark chocolate (cocoa mass, sugar, cocoa butter, and it may carry traces of milk), peppermint oil
snacks.feels: Cold from the machine. It snaps, then the mint goes cool in your mouth.
